about: Audible Genius presets from PresetShare, each rendered from its own MIDI demo in Primer and, after conversion, in Vital. Same notes, same tempo, no normalization.

patches.title: Boards of Canada - Sundown
notes: mono retriggered LFO in a poly patch: Vital restarts it per voice, so overlapping notes keep their own phase (Primer restarts the one LFO for every sounding note)

patches.title: DSG PL Prime
notes: FM depth matched at MIDI note 55 (Primer FM varies with the note)
